findings.proposal: Keep service status in the same Grid cell, with a 42-pixel top margin
findings.decision: Rejected in favor of a StackPanel containing input and status; the responsive routine moves the entire field cell and text height participates in layout. Fixed margin alone does not provide this guarantee.

findings.proposal: Measure service/status overlap in wide and narrow WPF layouts
findings.decision: Accepted as a test objective; implemented against actual loaded XAML, multiple viewports and zooms, including return to wide layout. Existing before-fix failures and passing final results retained.
